note: Vend-R post-Night-Market-Index supplement. These entries were audited directly from Night City 2045 and are kept separate from the January 2026 Night Market Index v1.24 shards.

audit_policy.include: Named purchasable products with reusable catalogue identity, a clear commercial role, or distinct mechanics.
audit_policy.exclude: Venue admission, transport, licences, accommodation, generic meals/drinks, rentals, and existing RED gear merely referenced by a location or NPC.
audit_policy.local_offerings: Named venue-specific food, drink, souvenirs and similar merchandise are retained as location/vendor offerings rather than promoted to global canonical catalogue entities.
